description: Run the AI operations as a developer app (ADR-014): POST /api/v1/chat, /generate, /summarize, /classify, /extract, /embed and GET /api/v1/runs/:id for the app's own runs. The app token (sub app:app_<ULID>, project_id prj_<ULID>, env sandbox|production, audience openvibe.ai) runs as its project: every run is metered (platform.usage-sample@1 to OpenVibe.Billing, subject project:prj_<ULID>) against the project's bounded free allowance, and metered capacity is spent only under the project's tier budget; a sandbox run, and every run no tier budget governs, uses only free and local capacity. An app runs only these operations (never a workflow by key), never reads another project's runs, and never uses a person's BYO provider key.
